items.exampleEn: The burglar took a computer and some jewelry.
items.exampleZh: 竊賊拿走了一台電腦和一些珠寶。

items.exampleEn: Talking is forbidden during the exam.
Her family plans to immigrate to another country when she finishes school.
items.exampleZh: 她家打算在她畢業後移民到別的國家。

items.exampleEn: Is it lawful to fish in this river?
The postman comes at ten every morning.
The air force band played at the city festival.
items.exampleZh: 空軍樂隊在城市的節慶上演奏。

items.exampleEn: My identity card has my photo and address on it.
items.exampleZh: 我的身分證上有我的照片和地址。

items.sentenceEn: The postman left a package at the door.
items.sentenceZh: 郵差在門口留下了一個包裹。

items.audioEn: Swimming is forbidden here after six, because nobody is watching the pool.
items.audioZh: 六點以後這裡禁止游泳，因為沒有人看守泳池。
items.questionZh: 為什麼六點以後禁止游泳？
options: No one is there to keep watch.
The water becomes too cold at night.
The pool is cleaned every evening at six.
It gets too dark to see.

items.sentenceEn: The police caught the burglar a week later.
items.sentenceZh: 一週後，警方抓到了那名竊賊。

items.sentenceEn: Don't forget to bring your identity card.

items.stemEn: My cousin joined the ____ because she wanted to fly planes.
items.stemZh: 我表姊加入了空軍，因為她想開飛機。

items.stemEn: Many people ____ every year to find work in this country.
items.stemZh: 每年都有許多人移民來這個國家找工作。

items.passageEn: My grandparents immigrated to this country forty years ago. My grandpa was a postman for thirty years, and my grandma worked as a cook for the air force. Last month, a burglar tried to break into their house at night. Luckily, the alarm went off, and he ran away. The police said that entering someone's home without permission is not lawful. They asked my grandparents to show their identity cards and write down what happened. When my grandma told us the story, her hands still trembled. Now my grandpa says the garden is forbidden to strangers, and he has put up a big sign.
items.passageZh: 我的祖父母四十年前移民到這個國家。我爺爺當了三十年的郵差，我奶奶則在空軍當廚師。上個月，一個竊賊半夜想闖進他們家。幸好警報器響了，他就逃走了。警察說，未經允許進入別人的家是不合法的。他們請我的祖父母出示身分證，並寫下事情的經過。奶奶告訴我們這件事時，雙手還在發抖。現在爺爺說花園禁止陌生人進入，還立了一塊大牌子。

options: 到警察局去認一認竊賊的長相
出示身分證並寫下經過
在家門口裝一台新的攝影機
暫時搬到兒子家去住幾天

items.promptZh: 我小時候，糖果在我們家是被禁止的。
referenceEn: When I was young, candy was forbidden in our house.
Candy was forbidden in our house when I was young.
rubricZh: forbidden 表示「被禁止的」，例如 It is forbidden to… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 identity card 造一個句子，說說你什麼時候需要出示身分證。
referenceEn: I need my identity card when I open a bank account.
I showed my identity card at the airport.
rubricZh: identity card 表示「身分證」，例如 show your identity card 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
